Here is my handoff for this round.

```
CORE_08 — Engineering_Snapshot

[Project]: WatchOver AI DevOps — lightweight human-in-the-loop AI DevOps workbench (portfolio prototype)

[Session]: council-session-002, 2026-09-26 (Council Member A snapshot)

[Decided Direction]: Three-workload experiment per SoT v0.1 — W1 discovery (RealWorld Angular + Django Ninja), W2 controlled A/B/C on Alerta, W3 sealed holdout — executed under Council Masters 01/02/03.

[Do Not Reopen]:
- Workload sets and run roles (SoT §1); alternate spring-angular-sso is activated only by Council decision.
- Bare Deployers see only the user-voice brief plus Master 01 §6 messages — no experiment, trap, acceptance or WatchOver disclosure.
- Roadmap §8 metric/acceptance semantics are frozen; operationalisation may not redefine them; null ≠ 0; negative results need coverage or a positive control.

[Why This Direction]: Separating the discovery workload from the evaluation workload stops WatchOver from being tuned to the very app it is scored on.

[Completed This Session]:
- Public candidate search, three-way scoring and shortlist → W1/W2/W3 assignment, ratified in SoT v0.1.
- Master 01 v1.0 (Deployer and run structure) and Master 02 v1.0 (Observer and measurement) merged by Council Member A.
- Master 03 v1.0 (Operations Coordinator control and reset) merged by Council Member B; Council Member A patch list P1–P8 delivered.

[Current State]: Three Masters merged and awaiting Human Operator freeze; Executor about to materialize child files; no cloud resources created; CORE_06-0a and harness validation not yet run.

[Unresolved Blockers]:
- Open Human Operator decisions: Master 01 §15 (P1–P4 etc.), Master 02 §13 (incl. D1 transcript-in-trace-corpus), Master 03 D1–D6, plus the P1–P8 patch acceptance.
- W1 is gated (Master 01 §0.3) on CORE_06-0a (pinned SHAs, A3 adapter, AI-context re-check) and on harness validation (transcript source and completeness).
- Cross-Master sync patches outstanding: Master 01 §6.2 approval phrase; Master 02 §2.2/§2.3 segment fields; Master 02 postmortem ordering (§6.2 step 9 vs §8.1).

[Next Entry Point]: Executor materializes the three Masters → Council checks the child files against the Masters → CORE_06-0a + harness validation → W1 run-entry gate.

[Success Signal]: RUN_W1_RESET_ATTESTATION = CLEAN with pinned SHAs, a frozen A3 adapter and a passing HARNESS_DRY_RUN_REPORT, all before W1 T0.

[Preserved Dissent]: Council Member A — the traceability corpus should exclude the raw transcript (Master 02 D1, Option W); the provisional majority default is Option T.
```

**One timing reminder.** If ‘first local blind test’ means W1's cloud run, three gates remain:

1. Your decisions on the open items above;
2. CORE_06-0a local screening;
3. Harness validation, especially complete transcript capture.

Transcript is Observer's sole evidence source. Running before validation could waste W1, and the test cannot be repeated.

If ‘blind test’ means CORE_06-0a local screening, that is the correct next step.

Roadmap Phase 0 ends 28 September; W1 ends 3 October. There is enough time; no need to skip gates for speed.

Thanks for the hard work, Human Operator. This was a dense session. See you next session.

# CORE_08 — Engineering_Snapshot

[Project]:  
WatchOver AI DevOps

[Session]:  
council-session-002 — 2026-09-26

[Decided Direction]:  
Proceed from the three Council Master documents into mechanical local materialization, then start W1 as the first Bare-AI blind deployment experiment after the frozen entry gates pass.

[Do Not Reopen]:  
W1/W2/W3 repository selection and experiment structure are closed; W1 is RealWorld discovery, W2 is the controlled Alerta comparison, and W3 remains sealed holdout.  
Operations Coordinator is a lightweight Run Controller / Evidence Custodian, not a command router, deployment assistant, Reviewer, or troubleshooting agent.  
Observer measurement remains isolated from the execution chain; ordinary deployment mistakes and false-success behavior are observed rather than corrected.

[Why This Direction]:  
The three-Master split now cleanly separates Deployer behavior, measurement, and run control while preserving blindness, comparability, evidence integrity, and a deliberately low Operations Coordinator workload.

[Completed This Session]:  
Council converged Master 01 covering Deployer/run structure, W1 package, W2 controlled structure, role visibility, and deferred treatment boundaries.  
Council converged Master 02 covering Observer isolation, incremental evidence intake, frozen metrics/acceptance semantics, traceability, W1 postmortem, and W2 comparison invariants.  
Council converged Master 03 around three event-driven control checkpoints, forced interruption, reset/isolation, evidence custody, project-wide residual verification, administrative cleanup separation, and lightweight Operations Coordinator operation.  
Cross-review resolved the major semantic drifts: M2/M8/M9/A3, scoped false-success, recovery coaching, Operations Coordinator command-routing drift, residual-zero evidence, and controller-overload risk.

[Current State]:  
Council design work is complete enough for the local Executor to materialize operational child files from the three Masters; no cloud blind run has yet been authorised.

[Unresolved Blockers]:  
Human Operator decisions explicitly retained by the Masters must be resolved during local materialization, including Master 03 D1–D6 and any remaining `PROPOSED / DECISION_FOR_HUMAN_OPERATOR` items.  
Before materialization, remove the stale leading `EMPTY PLACEHOLDER — Council draft pending` header from the current Master 03 file; the actual document below it is `MERGED DRAFT v1.0 — pending Human Operator freeze`. [Historical client citation 1; target unavailable in this captured record]  
W1 must not start until roadmap v0.2, CORE_06-0a, harness/control-instrument validation, all three frozen Masters, materialized run package, and the run-entry reset verdict are complete.

[Next Entry Point]:  
`COUNCIL_MASTER_03_OPERATIONS_CONTROL_AND_RESET.md` → clean the stale placeholder header, resolve retained Human Operator decisions during materialization, then mechanically generate the three-Master child-file set without adding new design decisions.

[Success Signal]:  
A frozen W1 package exists with CLEAN or Council-accepted KNOWN_LIMITATION reset attestation, validated evidence/control harness, pinned commits and acceptance adapter, allowing Human Operator to issue the W1 Bare-AI brief and begin the first blind run.

[Preserved Dissent]:  
The main surviving implementation choice is whether frozen read-only control/evidence scripts are invoked by Human Operator/designated verifier or explicitly by Operations Coordinator; this must be decided without weakening Operations Coordinator's no-deployment-command boundary.


From my side, **no need to reopen repository selection or experiment architecture**. If Operations Coordinator finds a real cross-Master conflict while drafting, bring the specific conflict to you; otherwise mechanically split files.

Good luck with the first W1 blind test. Next we finally see what GPT-5.6 Sol High actually does in a clean Bare environment, after all this rule-writing.
